One coordinated
practice.

MK Architect Studio brings architecture, structural engineering, MEP engineering and DOB expediting together under one coordinated team. The practice works across residential, educational, commercial and interior projects throughout New York.

We work closely with clients from early planning through approvals and construction, balancing design intent with budget, code requirements and practical delivery.
